name: RWARE / Robot Warehouse
description: Robots fetch shelves, deliver requested goods, and avoid blocking one another. / 机器人搬运货架、配送并避免相互阻塞。
comparability_warning: Sable Appendix B.1 explicitly says its Jumanji implementation terminates on a collision, unlike the original collision-resolution logic. Check the exact revision and wrapper before transferring scores.
metrics: Use delivery count/return, collision and early-termination rates. A time limit and a collision terminal are different outcomes.
getting_started: Start with tiny tasks; add warehouse size, number of robots and request difficulty separately. The original Python environment and Sable Jumanji setup are separate configurations.

name: Level-Based Foraging
reward: food collection; normalization depends on implementation
description: Agents combine levels to collect food that may be impossible to collect alone. / 智能体通过等级配合采集食物。
comparability_warning: force_coop, sight, food levels, normalization and episode limits change the task. Sable also modifies observation packing in its additional scalability experiment; do not silently apply that modification to all LBF runs.
metrics: Report return and food completion; define any joint-load event and its denominator. A positive conditional load-success rate does not imply higher total episode return.
getting_started: Use the original Python API for a small reset/step check; use the paper-pinned Jumanji/Mava configuration for a Sable comparison.

name: Connector
reward: connection reward plus step penalty in Sable
description: Agents draw non-crossing paths from start to target without trapping each other. / 路径一旦走过就会阻塞，需协作连接起点与终点。
comparability_warning: Sable Appendix B.4 gives a paper-specific observation and reward description. Paper labels such as con-5x5x3a are not guaranteed to be registered environment IDs.
metrics: Report connected-agent fraction, return and time to completion. Distinguish reward aggregation per agent from team sums.
getting_started: Use the smallest paper task before raising grid size and number of paths. Keep generator, wrapper and reward parameters with results.

name: SMAX
reward: combat shaping plus victory reward in Sable
description: A JAX combat simulator inspired by SMAC, without the StarCraft II engine. / 无需星际争霸引擎的 JAX 战斗协作环境。
comparability_warning: SMAX is not SMAC or engine-based SMACv2. The three smacv2_*_units labels in Sable are still SMAX tasks. Never merge their win-rate or return tables.
metrics: Record win rate and return separately, unit composition, opponent generator, attack availability and reward settings.
getting_started: Useful for accelerator-based combat experiments; separate compile time from steady-state throughput.

name: MaBrax
description: Agents control different joint groups of one robot. / 多个智能体共同控制机器人的不同关节。
comparability_warning: MaBrax uses Brax physics. Matching a MA-MuJoCo joint partition does not make simulation dynamics or reference returns identical.
metrics: Record robot, joint partition, observation radius, simulator backend and reward components; compare continuous-action-compatible baselines.
getting_started: Sable uses five robot/partition tasks. Start with a small partition; benchmark compilation and rollout separately.

name: MPE / MPE2
observation: scenario-dependent; do not assume every task is partially observable
description: Particle agents navigate, communicate or compete in a 2D world. / 二维粒子导航、通信和协作或竞争。
comparability_warning: Sable uses continuous JaxMARL simple_spread for 3/5/10 agents. MPE2 supports discrete and continuous actions and exposes a different action vector. This repository's MPE2 smoke example is not an exact Sable reproduction.
metrics: Record N, landmarks, local_ratio, action dimensionality, termination and max_cycles. The reward can be negative because distance and collision costs are penalties.
getting_started: Best first reset/step example here. Communication priors, MMQ and SS-MARL modify different parts of MPE; their scores belong to different task definitions.

name: SMAC
description: Control allied combat units against the built-in opponent. / 控制己方单位协同作战。
comparability_warning: Pin the StarCraft II build, maps, SMAC revision and reward mode. R3DM records SC2 4.10; another build is not automatically comparable.
metrics: Report win rate, return, map and evaluation action mode. Keep action-availability masks during evaluation.
getting_started: Requires external game installation. Validate one process before parallel workers; a learner GPU is not the same as the simulator process.

name: SMACv2
description: Randomized unit teams and starting conditions extend SMAC. / 随机化队伍与初始条件的战斗协作基准。
comparability_warning: Do not confuse engine-based SMACv2 with SMAX tasks named smacv2_*_units. Race, team generator, unit distribution and field of view must be recorded.
metrics: Report win rate and return over held-out episode seeds; separate training seeds from evaluation seeds.
getting_started: Run the provided optional protoss_5_vs_5 smoke recipe only after SC2 and the required maps are installed. Install cost is not a measured runtime estimate.

name: Multi-Agent MuJoCo
description: Split a MuJoCo robot's actuators among collaborating agents. / 将 MuJoCo 机器人执行器分配给多个智能体。
comparability_warning: Original MA-MuJoCo, newer wrappers and MaBrax must be tracked as separate implementations. Match partition, MuJoCo version and observation configuration.
metrics: Report episode return, robot, partition and evaluation noise. Do not compare values across different reward normalizations.
getting_started: Relevant for OptiMAPPO and MMQ. Use the implementation referenced by each paper rather than substituting a similarly named environment.

name: VMAS
description: Vectorized 2D multi-robot simulation with configurable scenarios. / 支持批量运行的二维多机器人仿真。
comparability_warning: A simulator family is not a single benchmark. DiCo tasks have their own observation, reward and goal-assignment choices. CAMAR uses VMAS as a throughput comparator, not necessarily a policy-quality baseline.
metrics: For diversity studies record SND, parameter sharing, goal assignment and reward in addition to entropy.
getting_started: Start with a documented scenario in BenchMARL. Record batch size and simulator device for throughput comparisons.

name: Google Research Football
reward: sparse scoring or shaped, by experiment
description: Cooperative football scenarios with passing, movement and scoring. / 通过传球、跑位和射门完成配合。
comparability_warning: Academy scenario, controlled-player count, observation representation, shared reward and scoring/checkpoint shaping are part of the task identity.
metrics: Report score/win or completion as appropriate, return, episode limits and reward mode.
getting_started: CEE, LAIES and g-MAT all use football, but sparse/dense settings must be checked before comparing their plots.

name: Overcooked
description: Two cooks coordinate ingredient preparation, cooking and delivery. / 两名厨师协同备料、烹饪与送餐。
comparability_warning: Different layouts, shaping schedules and wrappers change the problem. Overcooked and OvercookedV2 are distinct implementations.
metrics: Report sparse delivery score, shaped training reward separately, layout, horizon and partner protocol.
getting_started: Useful for role/partner experiments, but held-out partners and layouts must be designed explicitly; they are not guaranteed by a single training run.

name: CAMAR
description: Continuous multi-agent routing with obstacles and configurable dynamics. / 含障碍和不同动力学的连续多智能体路径规划。
comparability_warning: Holonomic versus other dynamics, maps, agent sizes and collision handling define different tasks. Reported simulator SPS is not a claim about learner end-to-end speed.
metrics: Use goal-reaching success, time/path quality and collision metrics together; retain the benchmark's tiered evaluation protocol.
getting_started: This edition provides a literature card and upstream links, without a local installation or a performance claim.

name: Didactic coordination games
description: Small games isolate coordination failures and relative overgeneralization. / 用可控小博弈隔离协作与相对过度泛化机制。
comparability_warning: RAC matrix games, MAGPO CoordSum, MMQ differential games and MAPO graph-coupled games are distinct tasks. This grouping is for discovery, not for pooling numerical results.
metrics: Publish payoff table, horizon, initial-state distribution, observation and optimal joint solution. A toy-game effect does not establish general benchmark improvement.
getting_started: Use for a fast mechanism check before a larger simulator. Select the exact game and retrieve the original implementation from the relevant paper card.

name: Open-system Wildfire
description: Agents and tasks can change during a wildfire-management episode. / 智能体或任务可在野火管理过程中变化。
comparability_warning: WS1 and openness mechanisms must be preserved. Do not infer the local action space or independent training seed count from the prose alone.
metrics: Record entry/exit rules, task changes, time of changes and return. Fixed-seed evaluation episodes are not independent training replications.
getting_started: Paper mapping only. Action-space details and install instructions are intentionally unresolved in this edition.

name: SUMO-RL traffic signals
description: Traffic signals cooperate through a road network. / 路口信号灯通过道路网络形成耦合控制问题。
comparability_warning: Road network, demand/routes, signal timings, SUMO version and reward definition affect results. The MAPO 28×7 experiment is a specific configuration.
metrics: Record team reward, queue length and waiting time; preserve the graph and local reward support.
getting_started: Useful for graph-local credit assignment. There is no claim that the large 196-signal experiment is a low-compute starting point.

name: OG-MARL
description: Datasets and baselines for learning from fixed multi-agent trajectories. / 基于固定多智能体轨迹学习的离线数据与基线。
comparability_warning: This is an offline data resource, not one of Sable's six online suites. Dataset version, source simulator, collection policies and train/evaluation protocol are part of its identity.
metrics: Record dataset quality, transition/episode counts, behavior coverage and online evaluation budget, if any.
getting_started: Added as a separate resource entry so online environments and fixed datasets are never conflated. Specific downloadable datasets are not enumerated here.

name: NEOM (Sable scalability task)
observation: position target and action-history description in paper
description: A synthetic cooperative task for scaling to many agents. / 用于大规模智能体扩展实验的合成协作任务。
comparability_warning: NEOM belongs to the additional scalability study, not the six-suite 45-task main performance benchmark. A current public API path is not verified in this edition.
metrics: Record agent count, solved coordination criteria, memory and throughput; distinguish recurrent context scaling from agent scaling.
getting_started: Consult Sable Section 4.2 and Appendix B.7. No local smoke recipe or current upstream API is asserted.
